candidates.scene: An unmistakable wordless question about a PERSON'S IDENTITY. At FAR LEFT two children: the QUESTIONER is in front and to the RIGHT of the listening child, so the listener is BEHIND and LEFT of the questioner. The questioner turns their face back to the listener, with a sharply raised questioning eyebrow, puzzled open mouth, head tilted, and LEFT palm up in a questioning shrug. Their RIGHT arm points unobstructed across a wide blank central gap DIRECTLY to one separate adult man at FAR RIGHT, with fingertip aligned to the man's face. The arm must not touch or cross the listener. The listener looks at the separate man thoughtfully. The man stands neutrally in plain green shirt, holding nothing, doing no activity, and is the sole object of the question. The clear relation is asking the companion WHO is that man, not greeting him or confidently introducing him. One simple human vignette, no setting or distracting props, no question marks or text.
